# RealScalar Trait Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Define `RealScalar` and implement it for `f32` and `f64` so Xenon's real-valued math APIs have a precise, sealed capability boundary with IEEE-754 semantics.

**Architecture:** `src/element/real.rs` owns the public `RealScalar` trait and the crate-private `RealScalarInternal` helper trait. Primitive impls live in `src/element/primitives.rs` and delegate to the standard library except for NaN-propagating `min` and `max`.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, std

**Design Docs:** `design/03-element.md` §5.3 (RealScalar), `design/03-element.md` §5.3a (RealScalarInternal), `design/03-element.md` §6.4 (NaN / Inf semantics), `design/03-element.md` §6.5 (f64 example impl)

**Prerequisites:** W4T6 must be complete.

### Task 2: Implement `RealScalar` and the primitive impls

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/element/real.rs`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the complete `real.rs` file**

Replace `src/element/real.rs` with the following content:

```rust
use crate::element::numeric::Numeric;
use crate::private::Sealed;

pub trait RealScalar: Numeric + PartialOrd + Sealed {
    fn abs(self) -> Self;
    fn signum(self) -> Self;
    fn sqrt(self) -> Self;
    fn sin(self) -> Self;
    fn exp(self) -> Self;
    fn ln(self) -> Self;
    fn floor(self) -> Self;
    fn ceil(self) -> Self;
    fn is_nan(self) -> bool;
}

pub(crate) trait RealScalarInternal: RealScalar + Sealed {
    fn epsilon() -> Self;
    fn min_positive() -> Self;
    fn max_value() -> Self;
    fn infinity() -> Self;
    fn neg_infinity() -> Self;
    fn nan() -> Self;
    fn is_infinite(self) -> bool;
    fn is_finite(self) -> bool;
    fn min(self, other: Self) -> Self;
    fn max(self, other: Self) -> Self;
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::RealScalar;

    #[test]
    fn test_real_scalar_bound_shape() {
        fn assert_real<A: RealScalar>() {}
        assert_real::<f32>();
        assert_real::<f64>();
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Append the `RealScalar` and `RealScalarInternal` impls to `primitives.rs`**

Append the following to `src/element/primitives.rs` before the test module:

```rust
use crate::element::real::{RealScalar, RealScalarInternal};

impl RealScalar for f32 {
    fn abs(self) -> Self { self.abs() }
    fn signum(self) -> Self { self.signum() }
    fn sqrt(self) -> Self { self.sqrt() }
    fn sin(self) -> Self { self.sin() }
    fn exp(self) -> Self { self.exp() }
    fn ln(self) -> Self { self.ln() }
    fn floor(self) -> Self { self.floor() }
    fn ceil(self) -> Self { self.ceil() }
    fn is_nan(self) -> bool { self.is_nan() }
}

impl RealScalar for f64 {
    fn abs(self) -> Self { self.abs() }
    fn signum(self) -> Self { self.signum() }
    fn sqrt(self) -> Self { self.sqrt() }
    fn sin(self) -> Self { self.sin() }
    fn exp(self) -> Self { self.exp() }
    fn ln(self) -> Self { self.ln() }
    fn floor(self) -> Self { self.floor() }
    fn ceil(self) -> Self { self.ceil() }
    fn is_nan(self) -> bool { self.is_nan() }
}

macro_rules! real_internal_impl {
    ($ty:ty) => {
        impl RealScalarInternal for $ty {
            fn epsilon() -> Self { <$ty>::EPSILON }
            fn min_positive() -> Self { <$ty>::MIN_POSITIVE }
            fn max_value() -> Self { <$ty>::MAX }
            fn infinity() -> Self { <$ty>::INFINITY }
            fn neg_infinity() -> Self { <$ty>::NEG_INFINITY }
            fn nan() -> Self { <$ty>::NAN }
            fn is_infinite(self) -> bool { self.is_infinite() }
            fn is_finite(self) -> bool { self.is_finite() }
            fn min(self, other: Self) -> Self {
                if self.is_nan() || other.is_nan() { Self::nan() } else if self <= other { self } else { other }
            }
            fn max(self, other: Self) -> Self {
                if self.is_nan() || other.is_nan() { Self::nan() } else if self >= other { self } else { other }
            }
        }
    };
}

real_internal_impl!(f32);
real_internal_impl!(f64);
```
